Governance

The bodies

Who does what.

01

Board of Directors

Provides institutional oversight, governance, fiduciary responsibility, and long-term strategic direction. Members

02

International Advisory Board

A distinguished, internationally recognized body — university leaders, current and former policymakers, ministers, diplomats, private-sector leaders, donor representatives, and leading scholars — reflecting the diversity and aspirations of the Global South and its partners. A platform for bridge-building across academia, policy, diplomacy, philanthropy, business, and innovation. Composition

03

Operational Team

Oversees day-to-day management, institutional operations, program implementation, partnerships, communications, and organizational sustainability. Leadership

04

Division Chiefs

Oversee the six core domains — Education, Training & Research · Technology & Innovation · Economy & Development · Creative Production & Cultural Industries · Global Cooperation & Sustainability · Convening, Dialogue & Knowledge Exchange — ensuring strategic alignment and cross-domain collaboration.

05

Regional Hubs & Coordination Unit

Coordinates GPS activities, partnerships, institutional engagement, and ecosystem development across regions. Each hub operates under a Regional Coordinator responsible for regional strategy, partnerships, programming, stakeholder relations, and institutional development. The hubs

⟡

Institutional documents. Statutes, policies, and governance charters are published as adopted — see strategic documents.

Connecting knowledge, technology and innovation, policy, and enterprise into measurable impact across the Global South. Headquartered in Kigali, Rwanda.
